rules.quote: The Assistants API was officially sunset on August 26, 2026, and is no longer available.
rules.summary: Calls the Assistants API, which OpenAI shut down on 2026-08-26, so these requests fail today. The move is not one-to-one: assistants become Prompts (configured in the dashboard), threads become Conversations, runs become Responses, and the tool-call loop moves into your code. Refit lists each call for review and does not rewrite it.

rules.quote: Access to these models was shut down on September 28, 2026.
rules.summary: Calls legacy Completions (`completions.create` / `createCompletion`). Every model it served (gpt-3.5-turbo-instruct, babbage-002, davinci-002) shut down on 2026-09-28, so the call needs a new model and a new API. OpenAI's Responses migration guide covers Chat Completions only; `prompt`, `suffix`, `echo`, `best_of` and `logprobs` have no documented mapping, so Refit lists it for review.
